text: Youngone Corporation of South Korea acquired 20% of Scott Sports in 2013 and 50.01% in 2015, taking the majority from Beat Zaugg; after a February 2025 International Chamber of Commerce arbitration ruling it is to hold 97% of Scott Sports and total control of the company.
short: Youngone Corporation of South Korea controls Scott Sports, holding ~97% after a 2025 ICC ruling.

source.name: Brújula Bike, 'SCOTT Sports is acquired by the South Korean company Youngone'
source.quote: With this decision, Youngone Corp will have 97% of the shares of Scott Sports and total control over all decisions of the company

additionalSources.name: Bicycle Retailer and Industry News, 'Scotts Sports owner Youngone loans company $176 million'
additionalSources.quote: It acquired a 20% share in Scott in 2013 and expanded it to 50.01% in 2015, taking over the majority position from Beat Zaugg
